integrity: Exact definitions and full proof, plus executable finite checks; no independent audit or comprehensive priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classifies idempotent Lie endomorphisms of finite-field Heisenberg Lie algebras, not arbitrary endomorphisms; finite exhaustive tests cover small prime fields and the general claim rests on the symbolic proof. General paired-subspace canonical form literature may overlap with the geometric portion of the proof.
title: Automorphism-orbit spectrum of Heisenberg Lie algebra retractions over finite fields
